summary: Compare a candidate with a declared baseline under repeatable workload, variance, resource, functional, and release-readiness gates.
triggers: A release needs measured latency, throughput, error, or resource budgets.
A candidate must be compared with a baseline under identical bounded conditions.
A performance result needs an explicit pass, fail, or inconclusive decision.
antiTriggers: Generate unapproved load against an external or production target.
Deploy because one benchmark happened to pass.
Claim field impact or production capacity from a synthetic fixture.

provenance.note: Method source read in full and independently rewritten for portable product use; the historical file remains unchanged.
Baseline, workload, variance, budget, functional, and proof-boundary semantics informed the rewrite; no source prose was copied.
Ownership and evidence boundaries were consulted; no release or performance result is asserted.
